Disclosure to Promote the Right To Information 

Whereas the Parliament of India has set out to provide a practical regime of right to 
information for citizens to secure access to information under the control of public authorities, 
in order to promote transparency and accountability in the working of every public authority, 
and whereas the attached publication of the Bureau of Indian Standards is of particular interest 
to the public, particularly disadvantaged communities and those engaged in the pursuit of 
education and knowledge, the attached public safety standard is made available to promote the 
timely dissemination of this information in an accurate manner to the public.

Indian Standard 

SPECIFICATION FOR 
TERMINALS FOR ELECTRONIC EQUIPMENT 

PART 2 DETAIL SPECIFICATION FOR TERMINALS 

Section 4 Terminal, Insulated, with Insulated 

Captive Screw Cap, Type TSC 4 



( Reaffirmed 2002 ) 



1- Scope — This standard (Part2/Sec4) covers detail requirements of terminals, insulated, with 
insulated captive screw cap, type TSC 4 and shall be read in conjunction with IS : 4007 ( Part 1 )-1982 
'Specification for terminals for electronic equipment : Part 1 General requirements and tests ( first 
revision)'. 

2. Climatic Test Severities 

Temperature severity 
Damp heat ( steady state ) 
Damp heat ( cyclic ) 
Low air pressure 
Vibration 

Impact 

3. Outline Drawing and Dimensions

56 days 21 days 

6 cycles 2 cycles 

4-4 kPa 30 kPa 

10 to 55 Hz, Duration — 6 hours 
Amplitude displacement — 0'75 mm 
500 m/s 2 , 5 minutes

Note 1 — Dimensions are in mill imetres. 

Note 2 — Unless otherwise specified, tolerances are + 0*40 mm. 
Note 3 — Adequate finger grip shall be provided. 

Note 4 — All insulated portion of terminals to be of same colour as of cap. 

Note 5 — The terminals may also have si de slotted construction with width of side slot = 3'2 mm. 
Note 6 — Screw threads according to IS : 4218 ( Part 2 )-1976 'ISO metric screw threads : Part 2 Diameter 
pitch combinations ( first revision )'. 



EXPLANATORY NOTE 

This standard is based on JSS 5271 0-Jan 1974 'Specification for terminals, captive screw cap 
and captive spring loaded', published by Ministry of Defence. In addition to climatic severities 
specified in JSS 52710-Jan 1974, the climatic severities for commercial usage have been included in 
this standard.
